author: Nfsoblx
quote: This is genuine garbage. I'm 20 hours in just finished act 2 and like where are the heists and all the fun stuff? I don't wanna hit up gas stations like a low level choad I want to see a planning board and rob like something crazy, a real damn heist. This whole hollywood slop is so annoying the whole idea of "lovers against the world" is stupid. I don't wanna spend all my time playing boyfriend simulator I want to steal a lambo and like run over a hooker and homeless people. Its actually crazy how safe this game is and how it tries to be like all inclusive and everything. The Rockstar from 10 years ago would have literally made fun of whatever garbage this is man. I don't care if it looks nice its so restrictive and the story is so bad I want to do fun stuff like a heist I don't wanna spend hours renovating a house and then have to spend time with a literal goomba. I don't get how people think Lucia is hot either she looks like a damn Goomba
